chapters.title: The garden's agreement

defineInvariant("every-plot-tended") with repairs: ["tend"]

chapters.title: Plantings, and the horizon
chapters.claim: A harvested planting leaves the counts but never the graph. The district says +1 past, and last season is one stop away rather than deleted.

chapters.title: A lens over the garden
chapters.claim: A lens binds roles, not field names. The coverage grid was written for requirements and tests; pointed at gardeners and plots it says, in a picture, which plot nobody tends.
